plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Art Education program page and its linked official degree map, 'Art & Art Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Art Education (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BFA Degree with Licensure: 120, which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/16/15/15/15/16/15/12) and the plan to 120. The catalog prints the Art Education Curriculum as 55 credits (Art Foundation 28 + Advanced Art 12 + one 15-credit Focus Track) plus Art Education Licensure at 30-33 credits (Art Education Core 12 + one 6-9 credit Option + Student Teaching 12). The map places every Foundation and Advanced Art course by name, carries the Advanced Art art-history choice (one of ARTH 3760, ARTH 4740 or ARTH 4750) as its Spring Year 3 'ARTH Major Upper-division Art History Elective' row, carries the Track as five generic 3-credit 'ART Major Track Course' rows totalling the catalog's 15 track credits, and carries the licensure Option as generic option rows totalling 9 credits, the top of the catalog's 6-9 credit option range. DISCLOSED CATALOG INCONSISTENCY (transcribed as printed, not reconciled): the catalog's Art Therapy Option lists four 3-credit courses (PSY 1010, PSY 1100, PSY 2010, and one of PSY 3600, PSY 3650 or PSY 4340), which sum to 12 credits and exceed the option block's printed 6-9 credit heading; the K-6 Endorsement Option (6 credits) and Museum Education Option (7 credits) do fall inside the printed range. The map prints ARTH 3750 as 'ART 3750'; the catalog code ARTH 3750 is recorded. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to count in the major, transfer students must complete at least 50% of their art credits at SUU, and BFA programs require students to apply for acceptance during the sophomore year. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates them ('Photography Principles: B&W/Darkroom', 'Life Drawing & Anatomy'). This program typically leads to Utah licensure/certification, per the catalog's Professional Licensure Disclosure.
